<div class="polarization-example" aria-label="Three synthetic months showing positive, zero and negative article shares, net score and proposed polarization index">
  <p class="polarization-intro">Three hypothetical government-months · 100 codable articles each · one measure at a time</p>
  <div class="polarization-table">
    <div class="polarization-table-head"><span>Coverage pattern</span><span>Share of articles</span><span>Net score N</span><span>Proposed P</span></div>
    <div class="polarization-table-row">
      <strong>All labels zero</strong>
      <div class="polarization-distribution" aria-label="0 negative, 100 zero, 0 positive articles"><span class="polarization-zero" style="width:100%">100%</span></div>
      <span class="polarization-value">0</span><strong class="polarization-value">0</strong>
    </div>
    <div class="polarization-table-row">
      <strong>Mostly positive</strong>
      <div class="polarization-distribution" aria-label="0 negative, 40 zero, 60 positive articles"><span class="polarization-zero" style="width:40%">40%</span><span class="polarization-positive" style="width:60%">60%</span></div>
      <span class="polarization-value">.60</span><strong class="polarization-value">0</strong>
    </div>
    <div class="polarization-table-row">
      <strong>Positive and negative</strong>
      <div class="polarization-distribution" aria-label="45 negative, 10 zero, 45 positive articles"><span class="polarization-negative" style="width:45%">45%</span><span class="polarization-zero" style="width:10%">10%</span><span class="polarization-positive" style="width:45%">45%</span></div>
      <span class="polarization-value">0</span><strong class="polarization-value">.81</strong>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="polarization-legend"><span><i class="polarization-negative"></i>Negative</span><span><i class="polarization-zero"></i>Zero</span><span><i class="polarization-positive"></i>Positive</span></div>
  <div class="polarization-formulas">
    <p><strong>N = p⁺ − p⁻</strong><span>Positive share minus negative share</span></p>
    <p><strong>P = 4p⁺p⁻</strong><span>High when both positive and negative shares are large</span></p>
  </div>
  <p class="polarization-takeaway">All-zero coverage and a positive–negative split both have net zero.<br>Read the shares alongside N and P: one score cannot show the whole pattern.</p>
  <p class="polarization-note">Zero-coded articles stay in the denominator; uncodable records are excluded. These are synthetic examples.</p>
